abstract_sentences.text: High-dimensional non-convex loss landscapes play a central role in the theory of Machine Learning.

evidence.anchor: loss landscapes play a central role

abstract_sentences.text: Gaining insight into how these landscapes interact with gradient-based optimization methods, even in relatively simple models, can shed light on this enigmatic feature of neural networks.
In this work, we will focus on a prototypical simple learning problem, which generalizes the Phase Retrieval inference problem by allowing the exploration of overparametrized settings.

evidence.anchor: generalizes the Phase Retrieval inference problem

abstract_sentences.text: Using techniques from field theory, we analyze the spectrum of the Hessian at initialization and identify a Baik–Ben Arous–Péché (BBP) transition in the amount of data that separates regimes where the initialization is informative or uninformative about a planted signal of a teacher-student setup.

evidence.anchor: analyze the spectrum of the Hessian at initialization

abstract_sentences.text: Crucially, we demonstrate how overparameterization can bend the loss landscape, shifting the transition point, even reaching the information-theoretic weak-recovery threshold in the large overparameterization limit, while also altering its qualitative nature.
We distinguish between continuous and discontinuous BBP transitions and support our analytical predictions with simulations, examining how they compare to the finite-N behavior.
In the case of discontinuous BBP transitions strong finite-N corrections allow the retrieval of information at a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) smaller than the predicted BBP transition.
In these cases we provide estimates for a new lower SNR threshold that marks the point at which initialization becomes entirely uninformative.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 quadratic teacher-student 初始化 Hessian 写成带 signal 结构的随机矩阵，用 field-theoretic resolvent/self-energy 得到 bulk edge 与 outlier crossing，解释 overparameterization 如何移动并改变 BBP transition，再以 finite-N 和初步 GD 观测闭环。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 保留模型、归一化损失、Hessian/overlap、BBP crossing、continuous/discontinuous 直观、Figure 1–4、p=infinity 的 p*(a+1)/2，以及 finite-N alpha_0 解释。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 将 replica/Feynman/1PI/Dyson、自洽方程、c_i/edge 判据、overlap residue、p* 扩展、一般 activation 和 dynamics 全部移入 Appendix A–F；这保持结果可扫读但增加理论复核成本。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 并排对照两类 overlap，Figure 2 合并 a/p 趋势与临界 insets，Figure 3/4 并置 large-N prediction、finite-N frequency 和 alpha_0；图与 Eqs. (15)–(18),(42)–(54) 对齐。
final_judgment.largest_gap: alpha_0 的线性外推及其随 N 回到 alpha_BBP 的预期没有完整识别；threshold-state BBP 未计算；Figure 8–10 的 error/shading 定义和 finite-N 元数据不足；一般 activation 只有 qualitative 支持。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 有谱 edge 和 finite-size observable 的论文，应在正文同时定义理论阈值、观测阈值、估计规则和极限顺序；完整推导可放附录，但相信图所需的量必须留在正文。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于理论—实验谱方法；真实数据或 deployment 还必须补齐数据生成、seed、误差定义、baseline、代码和运行成本，不能由 qualitative agreement 代替复现闭环。
